import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF295C_ {

    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    static int[][][] memoMin;
    static int[][][][] memoCount;
    static int budget;
    static int totalFifty, totalHundred;
    static boolean[][][] visitedMin;
    static long[][] nCrMemo;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = in.nextInt();
        budget = in.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (in.nextInt() == 50) totalFifty++;
            else totalHundred++;
        }

        setupCombinations();
        setupMinDp();
        int minSteps = computeMinSteps(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0);
        if (minSteps >= 1000000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        setupCountDp(minSteps);
        System.out.println(minSteps);
        System.out.println(countWays(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0, minSteps));

        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }

    private static void setupCombinations() {
        nCrMemo = new long[101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 100; j++) {
                nCrMemo[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
    }

    private static void setupMinDp() {
        memoMin = new int[2][51][51];
        visitedMin = new boolean[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(memoMin[i][j], -1);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void setupCountDp(int maxDepth) {
        memoCount = new int[2][51][51][maxDepth + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= maxDepth; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(memoCount[i][j][k], -1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int computeMinSteps(int f, int h, int side) {
        // f: number of 50kg people on starting side
        // h: number of 100kg people on starting side
        // side: 0 means boat is at starting side, 1 means boat is at destination side
        
        // Base case: all people are on the destination side and boat is back at start
        if (f == 0 && h == 0 && side == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // If boat is at destination and everyone is there, we need to bring boat back
        // But this state is only valid if we're done (which is handled above)
        if (f == 0 && h == 0 && side == 1) {
            return 1; // Need one more trip to bring boat back, but actually we don't need to bring it back
        }
        
        if (memoMin[side][f][h] != -1) {
            return memoMin[side][f][h];
        }
        
        if (visitedMin[side][f][h]) {
            return 1000000; // Cycle detected
        }
        visitedMin[side][f][h] = true;

        int best = 1000000;
        
        // Determine who can board the boat based on current side
        // If side == 0, boat is at start, so we take people from start to destination
        // If side == 1, boat is at destination, so we take people from destination back to start
        
        int availableFifty = side == 0 ? f : totalFifty - f;
        int availableHundred = side == 0 ? h : totalHundred - h;
        
        for (int takeF = 0; takeF <= availableFifty; takeF++) {
            for (int takeH = 0; takeH <= availableHundred; takeH++) {
                if (takeF + takeH == 0) continue;
                if (takeF + takeH > 0) {
                    int weight = takeF * 50 + takeH * 100;
                    if (weight <= budget) {
                        int newF = side == 0 ? f - takeF : f + takeF;
                        int newH = side == 0 ? h - takeH : h + takeH;
                        int result = computeMinSteps(newF, newH, side ^ 1);
                        if (result < 1000000) {
                            best = Math.min(best, 1 + result);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        visitedMin[side][f][h] = false;
        return memoMin[side][f][h] = best;
    }

    static int countWays(int f, int h, int side, int stepsLeft) {
        // Base cases
        if (stepsLeft < 0) return 0;
        
        if (f == 0 && h == 0 && side == 0) {
            return stepsLeft == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        
        if (stepsLeft == 0) return 0;
        
        if (memoCount[side][f][h][stepsLeft] != -1) {
            return memoCount[side][f][h][stepsLeft];
        }
        
        long total = 0;
        
        int availableFifty = side == 0 ? f : totalFifty - f;
        int availableHundred = side == 0 ? h : totalHundred - h;
        
        for (int takeF = 0; takeF <= availableFifty; takeF++) {
            for (int takeH = 0; takeH <= availableHundred; takeH++) {
                if (takeF + takeH == 0) continue;
                
                int weight = takeF * 50 + takeH * 100;
                if (weight > budget) continue;
                
                int newF = side == 0 ? f - takeF : f + takeF;
                int newH = side == 0 ? h - takeH : h + takeH;
                
                long comb = (nCr(availableFifty, takeF) * nCr(availableHundred, takeH)) % MOD;
                int sub = countWays(newF, newH, side ^ 1, stepsLeft - 1);
                total = (total + comb * sub) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        return memoCount[side][f][h][stepsLeft] = (int) total;
    }

    static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
        if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1;
        if (nCrMemo[n][r] != -1) return nCrMemo[n][r];
        if (r > n - r) r = n - r;
        return nCrMemo[n][r] = (nCr(n - 1, r - 1) + nCr(n - 1, r)) % MOD;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader bufferedReader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            bufferedReader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }

        public Scanner(String fileName) throws FileNotFoundException {
            bufferedReader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(fileName));
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(bufferedReader.readLine());
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return bufferedReader.readLine();
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return bufferedReader.ready();
        }
    }
}
